item.title: This movie kicked ass!
item.description: I watched the movie Kpop Demon hunters the otherday with some pals of mine. I didn’t expect it to hit me in the ol emotions so hard. Some song highlights for me are “free” and “what it sounds like”. If you haven’t watched it, I’d whole heartedly recommend you do!
